overview: Rainbow AI is a WhatsApp AI assistant for Pelangi Capsule Hostel & Southern Homestay. It handles guest inquiries, booking workflows, and multi-turn conversations via Baileys WebSocket. The focus is on reliability, response quality, and intent classification accuracy.
goals: Improve intent classification accuracy for booking and inquiry intents
Enhance conversation context handling for multi-turn dialogues
Add better fallback responses when AI confidence is low
Improve the booking workflow steps in workflows.json
Prioritize reliability and response quality over new features
Enforce strict business profile separation â€” each profile's data files must only contain content specific to that business, with zero contamination from other profiles
Fix data-makan and data-southern profiles which currently contain copy-pasted Pelangi Capsule Hostel content
Enhance multilingual support - complete Tamil coverage, language preference UI
Improve production readiness - liveness probes, graceful shutdown, monitoring
Optimize performance - cache language preferences, batch DB inserts
Improve user experience - webchat loading states, language selector

epics.title: Intent Classification Accuracy
epics.description: Improve how the system classifies incoming messages into the correct intent categories, especially for booking and inquiry intents.

epics.title: Multi-Turn Conversation Context
epics.description: Enhance the system's ability to track and use conversation context across multiple turns of dialogue.

epics.title: Fallback & Confidence Handling
epics.description: Improve responses when the AI has low confidence or cannot classify an intent reliably.

epics.title: Booking Workflow Improvements
epics.description: Improve the booking workflow steps, transitions, and validation logic in workflows.json and related pipeline code.

epics.title: Test Suite Reliability
epics.description: Fix failing tests and improve test coverage for core intent and conversation logic.

epics.title: Business Profile Separation
epics.description: Ensure strict data isolation between all business profiles. Each profile's data files (knowledge.json, intents.json, intent-keywords.json, routing.json, templates.json, workflows.json) must contain ONLY content specific to that business. No profile may contain identifiers, addresses, credentials, pricing, or intents belonging to a different business.

userStories.title: Add Tamil Sentiment Escalation Messages in Response Processor
userStories.description: defaultMessages in response-processor.ts only has en/ms/zh. Tamil guests get English. Add Tamil translations.
acceptanceCriteria: Test verifies Tamil guest gets Tamil message

userStories.title: Replace Hardcoded English Manual Handoff Message with Template Lookup
userStories.description: response-processor.ts line 474 has hardcoded English. Replace with getTemplate() for all 4 languages.

userStories.title: Add Missing Profiles to Workflow Error Handler profileDirMap
userStories.description: profileDirMap only maps pelangi/southern/makan. Missing yoongmei/pms-capsule/pms-southern.
acceptanceCriteria: Each maps to correct data directory
Test verifies correct error messages per profile

userStories.title: Cache Language Preference with In-Memory TTL to Avoid Per-Message DB Query
userStories.description: getConversationPreferredLanguage() issues DB SELECT every message. Add 5-min TTL cache keyed by phone.

userStories.title: Make Liveness Probe Return 503 When Critical Services Are Down
userStories.description: GET /health always returns 200. Add DB pool and WhatsApp checks - return 503 if down.
acceptanceCriteria: Test verifies 503 with mocked dead DB

userStories.title: Drain BullMQ Workers on Graceful Shutdown
userStories.description: Shutdown drains WhatsApp and DB but not BullMQ. In-flight jobs abandoned on SIGTERM.
acceptanceCriteria: Shutdown log includes BullMQ drain status

userStories.title: Guard Feedback setTimeout Against Server Shutdown
userStories.description: setTimeout for feedback prompt fires after HTTP server closes on shutdown. Store timer ref and clear on SIGTERM.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer refs stored in module-level Set
Test verifies no unhandled rejection on shutdown

userStories.title: Batch Fire-and-Forget DB Inserts in Intent Classifier
userStories.description: 10 separate sequential DB inserts per message. Batch with Promise.allSettled() to reduce pool pressure.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed inserts logged with structured error

userStories.title: Add Webchat Loading Skeleton State During Initial Page Load
userStories.description: Webchat shows empty shell during API calls. Add CSS skeleton animation until profile loads.
acceptanceCriteria: Replaced by content once profile loads

userStories.title: Add Language Preference Selector to Webchat UI
userStories.description: No way for guests to set language preference. Add dropdown for en/ms/zh/ta in chat header.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend respects explicit over ELD detection

userStories.title: Add TTL-Based Cache Invalidation for Recovery Messages
userStories.description: recoveryMessagesCache never evicts. Updates require restart. Add 10-min TTL.
acceptanceCriteria: No restart needed after JSON update

userStories.title: Remove Unsupported Languages from Admin Translation Dropdown
userStories.description: translation-helper.js shows Indonesian/Thai/Vietnamese but backend has no routing. Remove or add warning.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown only shows backend-supported languages or unsupported show warning

userStories.title: Skip Language Preference DB Query for T1/T2 Fast-Path Classifications
userStories.description: tier-classification.ts always awaits language DB query even for regex/fuzzy matches. Move after tier check.
acceptanceCriteria: T1 regex skips language DB query
T2 fuzzy skips language DB query
Test verifies no DB call on greetings

userStories.title: Increase Graceful Shutdown Timeout to 30 Seconds
userStories.description: Force-exit at 10s too short for LLM calls. Increase to 30s, log in-flight ops. Configurable via env var.

userStories.title: Replace Silent catch Blocks with Structured Debug Logging
userStories.description: 10+ bare .catch(()=>{}) in intent-classifier.ts. Replace with logger.debug() for visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: All bare catches replaced with logger.debug
Debug log includes operation name and error
No change to production log noise
